_comment: Template for the IAM identity management-ui's backend uses for its Athena/Glue archive search feature. __BUCKET_NAME__ is resolved at startup against its own s3.bucket config and written to {data_dir}/aws-setup/iam-policy.json -- paste that resolved file directly into the console's JSON policy editor (see docs/aws-setup.md). The Athena and Glue statements use Resource '*' because a properly scoped ARN needs the AWS account ID, which no component in this project ever discovers or is configured with -- these are read-only catalog/query-execution actions, not object-content access, which is why the S3 statements below (the actually sensitive part) are fully scoped instead. The AthenaResultsLocation/AthenaResultsListBucket statements assume the query-results prefix suggested in docs/aws-setup.md (athena-results/) -- update the prefix if a different one was chosen when configuring the workgroup.
